summary: An excellent, newly renovated four bedroomed property in the heart of Carlisle City Centre, nestled in the grounds of Carlisle Cathedral. The property benefits from a rear garden and parking spaces for two cars.
description:
Entrance hallway with stairs leading to first floor and a cloakroom with access to a ground floor W.C. Just off the hallway are two spacious reception rooms, each with traditional sash style windows and feature fireplaces.

Also on the ground floor is a kitchen/diner with appliances including oven, hob and extractor fan and allowing access to a useful utility room and door out to Rear garden.

To the first floor are three double bedrooms and one single bedroom, each have built in storage cupboards. There is also a separate bathroom and shower room providing the perfect set up for family living.

To the rear of the property is a walled and private garden with shed, and there are also two parking spaces provided with this property.

A fabulous and spacious property with period charm.

Services Mains Water, Electricity and Gas.
